resourceDetailPageBlock.title: Resource Detail Page
resourceDetailPageBlock.description: A full-width generic resource detail page with shared navigation, editable metadata, protection settings, tabs, and Markdown content.
resourceDetailPageBlock.guidanceBody: The application sidebar is shared with Resource List Page through one workspace shell. The detail body has no maximum-width constraint; its 25rem metadata rail stays on the left while the primary content consumes the remaining width. Replace example data and connect mutations through the component callbacks.
